mapper.select: SELECT kb_name AS kbName, COUNT(*) AS fileCount, SUM(chunk_count) AS chunkCount FROM knowledge_file GROUP BY kb_name ORDER BY kb_name

SELECT id AS fileId, kb_name AS kbName, title, document_type AS documentType, source, file_format AS fileFormat, file_size AS fileSize, chunk_count AS chunkCount, embedding_model AS embeddingModel, create_time AS createTime FROM knowledge_file WHERE (#{kbName,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR kb_name = #{kbName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) ORDER BY create_time DESC
